payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Domonique, Hattie, Lavonne, Romana

payload.content: Planning to claim ISSUE-0001::test as it aligns well with my testing skills and availability. Open to coordination if anyone else is aiming for this task.

Lavonne here. I see Domonique is planning to claim ISSUE-0001::test. I have good skills in testing and mobile-development but considering my availability and costs, I am looking at tasks with high or critical priority that fit within my 7 hours. I am considering ISSUE-0001::triage or ISSUE-0001::review due to lower costs and effort. Open to collaboration or suggestions from others to avoid overlap and maximize overall task coverage.

Lavonne here. To optimize coordination across all participants, I want to confirm that I am focusing on tasks with high or critical priority within my availability, specifically considering ISSUE-0001::triage and ISSUE-0001::review. Please share your intended claims or preferences so we can avoid duplications and maximize task completions collectively.

Romana here. Noticing Domonique plans to claim ISSUE-0001::test and Lavonne is considering ISSUE-0001::triage or ISSUE-0001::review. I have strong testing skills and 7 hours available. I am interested in ISSUE-0001::review or ISSUE-0001::docs as they fit my skill and availability with reasonable costs. Open to coordination to cover more tasks and avoid duplication.

Romana here from sprint coordination. I see Domonique aiming for ISSUE-0001::test, Lavonne considering ISSUE-0001::triage and review. I am targeting ISSUE-0001::review or docs with high priority and manageable cost. Let me know your preferences so we can maximize task coverage without overlap.

Hattie here. I see Domonique plans to claim ISSUE-0001::test, Lavonne considers ISSUE-0001::triage or review, and Romana targets review or docs. I have 8 hours and good testing skills, considering ISSUE-0001::triage for better cost and availability fit. Open to feedback to maximize coverage and avoid overlap.

Hattie here. To summarize, Domonique aims for ISSUE-0001::test, Lavonne leans towards ISSUE-0001::triage or review, Romana is eyeing review or docs, and I consider triage. Please confirm your final preferences so we can maximize task coverage without overlap. Open to suggestions.
Domonique confirms intention to claim ISSUE-0001::test for task coverage and skill alignment. Please finalize your claims to avoid duplicates and maximize sprint success.
Domonique reiterates commitment to ISSUE-0001::test task. If no conflicts arise, this will be the chosen task to optimize skill match and availability.

Lavonne here. I acknowledge Domonique's claim on ISSUE-0001::test. I see Romana and Hattie also considering ISSUE-0001::review and triage respectively. To avoid overlap, I am tentatively leaning towards ISSUE-0001::triage due to its lower cost and fitting my availability well. I am open to hearing if others have strong preferences for triage or review to coordinate better.

Lavonne confirms focus on high priority tasks within availability, specifically ISSUE-0001::triage with cost 1.22 and effort 1.2 hours, suitable for her skills and time. Inviting others to coordinate to maximize task coverage and avoid duplication.

Lavonne here. To all participants: please share your final intended claims soon so we can avoid duplicates and maximize the number of high-priority tasks completed in this sprint. I am currently leaning towards ISSUE-0001::triage but open to adjustments based on your inputs.

Romana acknowledges Domonique's claim on ISSUE-0001::test and Lavonne's focus on ISSUE-0001::triage. Romana confirms interest in ISSUE-0001::review or ISSUE-0001::docs to avoid overlap and maximize task coverage. Please confirm your final preferences soon for smooth coordination and optimal sprint success.

Hattie here. Confirming my interest in ISSUE-0001::triage due to good fit with my skills, cost, and availability. I see Domonique claims ISSUE-0001::test, Lavonne leans towards triage or review, and Romana targets review or docs. Let's finalize selections to maximize task coverage and avoid duplication.
